analysis: All four units are documentation-only (docs/architecture/inference.md head excerpts at lines 2036-2604; docs/developer/test.md metadata and patch). No executable code, wire protocol, key custody or authorization behavior changes in the supplied evidence. The visible inference.md text describes MiMo native serving, media decode accounting, Flint constraints and Bonsai/GLM notes. It restates existing controls: bounded media decode ahead of ImageIO/AVFoundation, memory-ledger charges, fail-closed ownership retention, content-free context errors, and MiMo MTP fail-open to target-only. The related T-041 prefix-cache statements (encrypted SSD, HMAC lookup tags, coordinator-authored salt) are consistent with the text: media stays noncacheable and target-only, and input_audio is excluded from text-only cache planning. The changed-range patch for the GLM variable-frame-rate video section (base 810-813) is not among the supplied text units. It is a doc change that says VFR tracks are now indexed at i/nominalFrameRate rather than refused. If the corresponding code change landed in this PR, the media decoder path (GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset, 512 MiB decoded cap) would merit review for resource bounds. That code is not supplied, so no finding is raised and the point is recorded as an unverified contract. test.md adds descriptions of new OpenRouter replay tests, with no security effect. No regression or threat-model invalidation is identified within the supplied evidence.
